definitions.explanation: An abbreviation of 国連安全保障理事会. The principal organ of the United Nations responsible for international peace and security. Consists of five permanent members with veto power and ten rotating non-permanent members.

examples.japanese: {安保理|あんぽり}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{決議|けつぎ}→決議：16467_ketsugi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{採択|さいたく}→採択：06784_saitaku⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: A resolution was adopted at the Security Council.

examples.japanese: {安保理|あんぽり}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{緊急|きんきゅう}→緊急：11327_kinkyuu⟧⟦{会合|かいごう}→会合：02605_kaigou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{開|ひら}かれた→開く：01979_hiraku⟧。
examples.english: An emergency meeting of the Security Council was held.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{安保理|あんぽり}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{非常任|ひじょうにん}{理事国|りじこく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{選出|せんしゅつ}→選出：14448_senshutsu⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{何度|なんど}→何度：17592_nando⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Japan has been elected as a non-permanent member of the Security Council numerous times.

notes:
USAGE:
The standard abbreviation used in news reporting. The full form ⟦{国連|こくれん}→国連：12035_kokuren⟧⟦{安全|あんぜん}{保障|ほしょう}→安全保障：05788_anzenhoshou⟧⟦{理事会|りじかい}→理事会：18635_rijikai⟧ is used in formal or first-mention contexts.

FULL FORM:
- ⟦{国連|こくれん}→国連：12035_kokuren⟧⟦{安全|あんぜん}{保障|ほしょう}→安全保障：05788_anzenhoshou⟧⟦{理事会|りじかい}→理事会：18635_rijikai⟧ (United Nations Security Council)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {安保理|あんぽり}⟦{決議|けつぎ}→決議：16467_ketsugi⟧ (Security Council resolution)
- {安保理|あんぽり}{常任|じょうにん}{理事国|りじこく} (permanent member of the Security Council)
- {安保理|あんぽり}⟦{改革|かいかく}→改革：04815_kaikaku⟧ (Security Council reform)
